top_story_title: Check Point Security Gateways exploited via PHP2Shell to deploy a VMware ESXi wiper
top_story_summary: Vulnerable Check Point Security Gateway instances have been targeted in PHP2Shell attacks, and the reported attack chain did not stop at the perimeter: the intruders went on to deploy data-wiping malware on VMware ESXi hosts behind the gateway. The source does not name a CVE, an affected Fireware/Gaia build, or a fixed release, so treat version questions as open until the vendor advisory answers them.
top_actions: Inventory internet-facing Check Point Security Gateway instances and confirm each running build against Check Point's advisory; check the vendor advisory for the fixed release, as none is stated in the reporting.
Remove gateway management access (HTTPS/SSH/API/portals) from untrusted and internet-facing interfaces; restrict to a dedicated management VLAN or out-of-band network.
Hunt for webshells: unexpected PHP or script files under web-served directories, files with recent mtimes that do not match a change record, and new outbound connections from the gateway.
Rotate local admin credentials, API keys, certificates and VPN pre-shared keys on any gateway that was internet-exposed - a pre-patch compromise survives an upgrade.

Verify the ESXi management network is not reachable from gateway-facing segments, enforce MFA on vCenter/ESXi administrative access, and confirm that host and VM backups are offline and test-restorable.
executive_summary: Check Point Security Gateways were exploited in PHP2Shell attacks that ended in data-wiping malware on VMware ESXi hosts - destructive, with no CVE or fixed release stated in the reporting.

Cisco's October 2026 Node.js bundle advisory carries CVE-2026-111497, a Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write already on the CISA KEV list (added 2026-10-27, due 2026-11-10), plus two TLS hostname-validation bypasses.

Eight eMudhra intermediate CA private keys are brute-forceable in seconds; Cisco has issued an emergency-distrust informational advisory, so any device trust store or IPsec/TLS path relying on that chain needs review.
An unauthenticated XXE in Cisco BroadWorks OCI-P leaks filesystem contents with no workaround - fixed software only.
Quiet window: four items, none AI-related, and no new vendor AI defence announcements.
key_actions: **Check Point** — Confirm the running version of every Check Point Security Gateway against Check Point's fixed-release table and schedule the upgrade in the change window, HA pair secondary first; check the vendor advisory for the fixed release.
**Check Point** — Remove management and portal access (HTTPS/SSH/API) from untrusted and internet-facing interfaces immediately; restrict to a dedicated management VLAN or out-of-band network.

**Cisco** — Match your Cisco estate against the advisory's affected-products table and check the vendor advisory for the fixed release per product - do not assume a single train fixes everything in the bundle.
**Cisco** — Prioritise any affected product whose web, API or management interface accepts Brotli-compressed requests from untrusted networks, since that is the KEV-listed path.

**Cisco** — Check each Cisco product in use against the advisory's list and apply the distrust update Cisco specifies for it; check the vendor advisory for the fixed release or trust-bundle version, since the advisory is being updated as review continues.

**Cisco** — Inventory device trust stores - firewalls, VPN gateways, wireless controllers, RADIUS/ClearPass-style policy servers, load balancers - and remove the eMudhra roots and intermediates named in the advisory, not only on Cisco gear.

headlines.title: Check Point gateways hacked via PHP2Shell to deploy VMware ESXi wiper
headlines.summary: Vulnerable Check Point Security Gateway instances were exploited in PHP2Shell attacks that deployed data-wiping malware on VMware ESXi hosts.

headlines.title: Vulnerabilities in Node.js and Brotli Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026
headlines.summary: Cisco's October 2026 Node.js bundle advisory includes CVE-2026-111497, a KEV-listed Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write with potential remote code execution.

headlines.title: Cisco Informational for Emergency Distrust of eMudhra Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities
headlines.summary: Private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate CAs can be brute-forced in seconds, and Cisco has issued an emergency-distrust informational advisory for affected products.

headlines.title: Cisco BroadWorks Out-of-Band Blind XML External Entity Injection Vulnerability
headlines.summary: An unauthenticated attacker can read sensitive configuration files from Cisco BroadWorks via crafted XML to the OCI-P service; fixed software is out and there is no workaround.
